name: AdvancedEncryption.WE.BKSStar.shared_inner_admissible
title: Cartesian admissibility of public first-row identifiers and shared overrides
statement: For any nonempty suffix and every tuple of queried rows, replacing the target aggregator by a dummy fallback and attaching its precomputed ciphertexts to every selected row preserves all aggregate outputs under each issued key.
